description:
Masking behaviour of the whole pipeline, for known and unknown fingerprints. Shared vectors: the Python SDK is the source of truth and any other SDK runs the same file and must reproduce every expected value exactly. Each case is {name, op, input, expected}; op names one of the operations below. JSON bodies are source text, masked bodies are Python json.dumps text, and form and query output is urlencode(doseq=True) text; compare them as strings. A string of many equal characters is written {"$repeat": "a", "times": 65537}, and a string made of such parts {"$concat": [...]}; expand them before use.
Operations used in this file:
- pipeline_process: input {polls, request, salt}; salt is the STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT string or null; build an empty rules cache and feed it each poll in order, as the answer of the sync endpoint ({status, body}: status 0 is a network error, body null when there is none), then process request ({method, url, req_headers, req_body, resp_status, resp_headers, resp_body}) unless it is null. expected {payload, cache}: payload is the whole payload without sdk_version (each SDK checks its own), or null; cache is {cursor, first_sync_done, project_defaults}, where project_defaults is null or {field_masks (sorted), regex_count, unusable}.
